title: Topic 1 ● 食事
japanese_text: 昨日、久しぶりに友だちとスイーツ<u>ビュッフェ</u>に行った。<u>壁一面</u>がパステルカラーで、メニューには、カラフルなケーキや、<u>綿あめ</u>があったりして、とてもかわいかった。
english_translation: Yesterday, I went to a sweets buffet with a friend for the first time in a while. The walls were pastel-colored, and the menu had colorful cakes and cotton candy, which was all very cute.
